seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in St. Helena, California for 2026: an old mill holiday day, library crafts and gallery carolers, with dates and prices checked.
lede: St. Helena keeps Christmas small and walkable, with a holiday day at the historic Bale Grist Mill, children's crafts at the library and carolers on Main Street.
celebrates: St. Helena celebrates in the heart of the Napa Valley with small, local events. Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park opens its restored 1840s mill for Old Mill Holidays, the St. Helena Public Library offers a winter diorama party and a drop in crafts afternoon for children, and Meuse Gallery hosts Christmas carolers on four days in mid December. The town is also the northern end of the Napa Valley Wine Train, so a holiday ride can start in Napa and finish in St. Helena.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for St. Helena's family holiday events, so this page leans on this year's host listings. The state parks page for Bale Grist Mill still describes the previous year's Old Mill Holidays, and the town's tourism listing carries the 2026 date. The Barrel Tree Lighting that opens the season took place on November 25 this year and is already over.
facts: Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park sits at 3369 St. Helena Highway between St. Helena and Calistoga. Its restored wooden water wheel and mill stones date from the 1840s, and the park lets visitors see how water power turned grain into flour for settlers in the valley. Our Wine Train guide says the train runs from Napa north to St. Helena and back, a round trip of about 36 miles.
trains: The Napa Valley Wine Train runs from Napa north to St. Helena and back, a round trip of about 36 miles along State Route 29, according to our museum guide. Since 2009, passengers have also been able to get off in St. Helena on certain days. The line was finished by Samuel Brannan in 1864 to carry visitors to his Calistoga resort, and the Wine Train restored passenger service on September 16, 1989.

faq: How does St. Helena celebrate Christmas?

St. Helena keeps its season small and local. Bale Grist Mill State Historic Park hosts Old Mill Holidays, the St. Helena Public Library runs children's crafts and a diorama party, Meuse Gallery presents Christmas carolers, and the Barrel Tree Lighting opens the season in late November. Our page lists the 2026 dates and prices.
Is there a Christmas train near St. Helena?

Yes. The Napa Valley Wine Train runs from Napa north to St. Helena and back, and offers a Santa Train Jolly Journeys ride on daytime departures in late December. Those rides leave from Napa, not St. Helena, so check the Napa page for dates. The Western Railway Museum in Suisun City also runs Santa Trains.
How much does Bale Grist Mill cost at Christmas?

The 2026 listing from the St. Helena tourism calendar shows $5 for Old Mill Holidays, from 10 am to 2 pm. The California State Parks page still shows the previous year's event, so call the park to confirm the date and the price before you drive up, especially with young children in the car.
Does St. Helena have its own page for kids' events?

Yes, because it has three verified events this year: the old mill holiday day, the library programs and the Meuse Gallery carolers. Yountville, a smaller town to the south, has only one verified event this year and is covered on our Napa page.
